tagline.en: Blackjack, Dice, Mines and Case Battle get a new look.
tagline.id: Blackjack, Dice, Mines, dan Case Battle tampil baru.

items.en: Blackjack: a real casino table with a wooden rail, printed lettering, card shoe, chip tray and card spots. Hands sit in the middle.
items.id: Blackjack: meja kasino sungguhan dengan pinggiran kayu, tulisan di meja, kotak kartu, wadah chip, dan tempat kartu. Kartu di tengah.

items.en: Dice: a red 3D die tumbles on every roll, the target has a visible handle and the result floats above the bar.
items.id: Dice: dadu merah 3D berputar tiap lemparan, target punya pegangan yang terlihat, dan hasil melayang di atas bar.

items.en: Mines: stone blocks and faceted emerald crystals. Case Battle: You vs Bot face-off before the battle starts.
items.id: Mines: balok batu dan kristal zamrud. Case Battle: tampilan Kamu vs Bot sebelum battle dimulai.
